e2e.auth_notes: A fresh schema has no users. The flow registers the first account, which Roller makes the site administrator; its credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Registering the first user inserts one roller_user row and two userrole rows (admin, editor). Roller keys every row by a random UUID and stamps datecreated, so rows are matched on their natural keys (username, rolename) and id/datecreated are ignored. passphrase is an unsalted SHA digest of the password, hence stable. roller_permission and weblog are declared so a change outside the spec shows up; the flow creates no weblog.
